createOrReplace.title: Computer Science | Cambridge
createOrReplace.excerpt: Entry requirements for entry in 2027 or deferred entry in 2028. Minimum offer level A level: A*A*A. IB: 41-42 points, with 776 at Higher Level. You will need A levels/IB Higher Levels (or the equivalent) in Mathematics; Further Mathematics to AS or A level if your school offers it. All applicants for Computer Science are required to take the Test of Mathematics for University Admission (TMUA).
